chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from 'Umar ibn Aban, from Sa'id ibn al-Hasan, who said:
Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said: The beginning of the time is the sun’s decline from the meridian, and it is Allah’s first appointed time, and it is the more excellent of the two.

key_terms.أَفْضَلُهُمَا: the more virtuous of the two times
key_terms.أَوَّلُ الْوَقْتِ: the beginning of the prescribed prayer time
key_terms.زَوَالُ الشَّمْسِ: the sun’s decline from the meridian, marking the start of Zuhr time
key_terms.وَقْتُ اللَّهِ الْأَوَّلُ: the first divinely appointed time for the prayer

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Zuhr begin, and is praying at its earliest time more virtuous?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the beginning of the time for the noon prayer is at the sun’s decline from the meridian. It also indicates that this earliest time is the most virtuous of the two prayer times being discussed.
